caption: The drawing depicts a wooden, U-shaped object resembling a yoke, commonly used for harnessing draft animals. The main component is a curved piece of wood, showcasing a natural brown color with visible wood grain and knots, indicating it is a solid, unpainted wood. Attached to each end of the yoke are elongated, darker brown metal plates, each with a circular metal ring at the farthest point. Two downward-projecting, short wooden pegs are fixed at the bottom ends of the yoke. The composition is centered on a plain, light, off-white background with no additional objects or features, focusing attention on the detailed rendering of the yoke's shape, texture, and construction.
title: Oxen Yoke
